Danny Minton

Democratic candidate for U.S. Representative, District 6, Dallas County, Texas · Challenger

Vice president of sales at Clarix Imaging; surgical technology specialist

Danny Minton is the Democratic nominee for U.S. House in Texas' 6th Congressional District. He ran unopposed in the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary and won 41,790 votes. He faces incumbent Republican Jake Ellzey in the November 3, 2026 general election and has never held elected office.

Where Minton stands

Election integrity / voter registration
Supports fair maps, secure elections and easy access to the ballot. Says Texas elections should be secure and accessible, and that politicians should not get to pick their voters.
Immigration enforcement
Supports a secure, well-managed border and a return to civil immigration enforcement. Calls for ending family separation and mass detention, and says federal agencies should stay out of local policing in cities.
Health care
Says health care is a right. Supports universal, affordable health care and points to Medicare and the VA as models.
Public education
Supports a stronger U.S. Department of Education and proposes making school vouchers illegal nationwide.
War powers
Proposes requiring a congressional vote before troops are sent into lasting conflicts, setting time limits on military action, and repealing outdated war authorizations.
Social Security, Medicare and veterans' benefits
Opposes any attempt to weaken Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid or the VA, and calls these benefits earned promises.
Taxes and economy
Supports tax cuts for working- and middle-class families and higher taxes on the wealthiest Americans. Also calls for higher wages and support for small businesses.
